text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Broadview Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Toronto and East York Community Council directed Transportation Services to conduct a review of various safety and operational concerns for road users on Mortimer Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Broadview Avenue. This report provides an overview of the assessments and improvements proposed or undertaken by Transportation Services.

City Council on October 9 and 10, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate a Community Safety Zone in effect at all times, on: a. both sides of Mortimer Avenue, between Logan Avenue and Pape Avenue; and b. both sides of Logan Avenue, between Gowan Avenue and Mortimer Avenue. 2. City Council request the General Manager, Transportation Services to investigate the feasibility of Automated Speed Enforcement on Mortimer Avenue between Logan Avenue and Pape Avenue. 3. City Council request the General Manager, Transportation Services to report back on the feasibility of installing an advance left turn signal for Westbound traffic at the intersection Broadview Avenue and Mortimer Avenue. 4.
